row.body: The listing key is returned to the office before the viewing ends. The property sheet says the house was empty, but a visitor left a meal receipt inside.
row.title: The low-price key

sidecar.gloss: An empty-house record conflicts with an item left during a viewing.
sidecar.rival_reading: A routine showing could finish early and leave an old receipt; the sheet does not identify when the room was last occupied.

row.body: the lug wrench and hand torch are wedged beneath unused warning tape. footprints pass around the bundle rather than toward it.
row.title: missing count beside the lug wrench

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
